nasa-power-climatology.title: NASA POWER MERRA-2 monthly meteorological climatology
nasa-power-climatology.method: T2M mean air temperature (°C), PRECTOTCORR mean daily precipitation (mm/day), requested with start=1991/end=2020 and checked against every returned header.range. Monthly precipitation = rounded source daily mean × mean Gregorian month length across 1991–2020.

noaa-oisst-climatology.title: NOAA OISST v2.1 0.25° monthly SST climatology
noaa-oisst-climatology.license: NOAA data may be used and redistributed for free; acknowledgement requested
noaa-oisst-climatology.method: Nearest valid 0.25° ocean grid cell within 100 km of a beach-tagged destination; all 12 months present and ≥27 valid years per month. Inland destinations and unavailable ocean cells have null water temperatures.

file_metadata.title: NOAA/NCEI 1/4 Degree Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST) Analysis, Version 2.1
file_metadata.dataset_title: NOAA Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature
file_metadata.comment: Reynolds, et al.(2007) Daily High-Resolution-Blended Analyses for Sea Surface Temperature (available at https://doi.org/10.1175/2007JCLI1824.1). Banzon, et al.(2016) A long-term record of blended satellite and in situ sea-surface temperature for climate monitoring, modeling and environmental studies (available at https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-8-165-2016). Huang, B., C. Liu, V. Banzon, E. Freeman, G. Graham, B. Hankins, T. Smith, and H.-M. Zhang, 2021: Improvements of the Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (DOISST) Version 2.1 (available at https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI-D-20-0166.1). Anomaly is based on 1971-2000 OI.v2 SST. Satellite data: multi-satellite sensor (AVHRR+VIIRS) data. Ice data: NCEP Ice and GSFC Ice. Data less than 15 days old may be subject to revision.
file_metadata.not_missing_threshold_percent: minimum 3% values input to have non-missing output value
